title: Instance properties panel doesn't fill the Properties pane width (MC instance selected)
description:
REPRO: Select a MovieClip/symbol INSTANCE on the stage. Right pane -> Properties tab renders the Transform/Instance/Align/Info PanelGroup stack. The Instance properties section does NOT stretch to the pane's full width; it stops short, leaving empty space on the right. Sibling panels (Transform, Align) fill the pane normally.

ROOT CAUSE: packages/authoring-ui/src/InstancePanel.tsx line 29-38, the `styles.panel` root container hardcodes `width: "200px"` together with `flexShrink: 0`. The InstancePanel root is mounted inside a PanelGroup content wrapper in Shell.tsx (rightTab==="properties" branch, ~line 3819-3825: <PanelGroup title="Instance"><InstancePanel .../></PanelGroup>). PanelGroup.tsx wraps children in a full-width block div (<div style={{padding:"4px 0"}}>). The sibling TransformPanel root (TransformPanel.tsx line 43-50, styles.panel) sets display:flex/flexDirection:column with NO width, so it fills the wrapper; AlignPanel likewise fills. InstancePanel's fixed 200px overrides that and caps it, so when the Properties pane is wider than 200px the Instance content can't reach the edge.

MEASURED WIDTHS (Playwright e2e on :1420, wide 1400px viewport, MC instance selected, Properties tab active): Properties pane (data-testid=right-panel) computed width = 240px; InstancePanel root computed width = 200px (getComputedStyle .width === '200px'). 40px empty gap on the right. The element that stops short is the InstancePanel `styles.panel` root div.

EXPECTED: Instance properties fill the pane horizontally like the Transform/Align panels (panel root width == pane content width).
ACTUAL: Instance root fixed at 200px; pane is wider (240px measured) -> empty space on the right.

REGRESSION VERDICT: LONG-STANDING, NOT a re-theme regression. git blame: `width:"200px"` + `flexShrink:0` were present from the file's initial creation (commit 4b4e4cf "initial progress"). The Flash 8 re-theme (commit 4b23421, task 1248 'inspector group -> light Halo') only changed background/border colors on this style block and left the fixed width untouched. So the narrowness predates the re-theme.

FIX DIRECTION: On InstancePanel.tsx `styles.panel`, remove the fixed `width: "200px"` and `flexShrink: 0` and let it fill — e.g. set `width: "100%"` (or `alignSelf: "stretch"` / `flex: 1` as appropriate) to match TransformPanel/AlignPanel which set no fixed width. Verify with a Playwright computed-width check that InstancePanel root width == Properties pane content width after the fix.

HEAD at investigation: 8ef4ad7151cdaaf595c2b3897c825a617ceb334f. Files: packages/authoring-ui/src/InstancePanel.tsx:29-38 (root cause); packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:~3819 (mount); packages/authoring-ui/src/PanelGroup.tsx:53-56 (wrapper); packages/authoring-ui/src/TransformPanel.tsx:43-50 (sibling that fills, for comparison).
